name: Hydrogen
summaryZh: 最轻的分子，两个氢原子以单键结合。宇宙中丰度最高的分子。
summaryEn: The lightest molecule: two hydrogen atoms joined by a single bond, and the most abundant molecule in the universe.
usesZh: 燃烧只产生水，被视为最干净的燃料；工业上大部分氢其实用于合成氨造化肥。
usesEn: Burning it yields only water, making it the cleanest fuel; industrially, though, most hydrogen goes into ammonia for fertiliser.

name: Oxygen
summaryZh: 空气中约占 21%，以双键结合。基态为三重态双自由基，因此具有顺磁性。
summaryEn: About 21% of air, held by a double bond. Its triplet ground state makes it a diradical, which is why oxygen is paramagnetic.
usesZh: 呼吸和燃烧都靠它。医院的供氧、炼钢的吹氧、焊枪的助燃，本质上都是同一件事。
usesEn: Breathing and burning both need it — hospital oxygen, oxygen steelmaking and a welding torch are all the same reaction.

name: Nitrogen
summaryZh: 空气的主要成分（约 78%）。氮氮三键键能极高，使氮气非常稳定。
summaryEn: The main component of air (~78%). Its nitrogen-nitrogen triple bond is one of the strongest known, making N2 very unreactive.
usesZh: 化学上极不活泼，正好用来隔绝氧气：薯片袋里鼓鼓的气体就是氮气，防止油脂氧化变味。
usesEn: Its unreactivity is the point — it keeps oxygen out. The puff of gas in a crisp packet is nitrogen, stopping the oil going rancid.

name: Chlorine
summaryZh: 黄绿色有毒气体，氧化性强，常用于自来水消毒。
summaryEn: A yellow-green toxic gas and strong oxidiser, widely used to disinfect drinking water.
usesZh: 自来水厂投氯杀菌是现代城市能大规模安全供水的前提，也是公共卫生史上最有效的措施之一。
usesEn: Chlorinating tap water is what makes safe city-scale water supply possible, and one of the most effective public-health measures ever adopted.

name: Ozone
summaryZh: 平流层臭氧层吸收紫外线。图中画的是一种路易斯结构，实际两个 O—O 键完全等长，为共振离域。
summaryEn: Stratospheric ozone absorbs ultraviolet light. One Lewis structure is drawn here; in reality both O-O bonds are identical, delocalised by resonance.
usesZh: 高空的臭氧层挡住紫外线，是地表生命的前提；地面的臭氧则用于杀菌，但吸入有害。
usesEn: High up, the ozone layer blocks ultraviolet and makes surface life possible; at ground level it disinfects, but is harmful to breathe.

name: Fluorine
summaryZh: 淡黄色气体，已知氧化性最强的单质，几乎能与所有元素反应。
summaryEn: A pale yellow gas and the strongest elemental oxidiser known, reacting with almost every other element.
usesZh: 本身太危险不能直接使用，但几乎所有含氟产品都由它制得 —— 从不粘锅到牙膏再到核燃料。
usesEn: Too dangerous to handle directly, yet nearly every fluorine product starts from it — non-stick coatings, toothpaste, even nuclear fuel.

name: Bromine
summaryZh: 常温下唯一的液态非金属单质，深红棕色，易挥发。
summaryEn: The only nonmetal that is liquid at room temperature: a dark red-brown liquid that evaporates readily.
usesZh: 溴化银对光敏感，胶片摄影的整个原理就建立在它上面；溴系阻燃剂则曾遍布电子产品外壳。
usesEn: Silver bromide is light-sensitive, which is the entire basis of film photography; brominated flame retardants were once everywhere in electronics.

name: Iodine
summaryZh: 紫黑色固体，受热直接升华为紫色蒸气。遇淀粉显蓝色。
summaryEn: A violet-black solid that sublimes straight to a purple vapour, and turns starch deep blue.
usesZh: 碘酒和碘伏是最常见的伤口消毒剂；食盐加碘则解决了大范围的甲状腺肿和儿童发育问题。
usesEn: Tincture of iodine and povidone-iodine are the most familiar wound antiseptics; iodised salt solved widespread goitre and developmental problems.

name: White phosphorus
summaryZh: 四个磷原子构成正四面体，每个键角只有 60°，张力极大 —— 这正是白磷能在空气中自燃的原因。
summaryEn: Four phosphorus atoms at the corners of a tetrahedron. The 60° bond angles are hugely strained, which is why white phosphorus ignites spontaneously in air.
usesZh: 接触空气就会自燃，必须存放在水下。主要用来制磷酸和磷肥，军事上则作燃烧弹和烟幕弹。
usesEn: It ignites on contact with air and must be stored under water. Mostly converted to phosphoric acid and fertiliser; militarily used in incendiaries and smoke.
everydayZh: 早期火柴（因中毒已禁用）

name: Sulfur
summaryZh: 常见的斜方硫由 S₈ 环组成，八个硫原子上下交错形成"皇冠"，并非平面环。
summaryEn: Ordinary sulfur is built from S8 rings. The eight atoms alternate above and below the mean plane, forming a crown rather than a flat ring.
usesZh: 轮胎之所以又弹又耐磨，是因为硫在橡胶分子间架起了交联桥 —— 这就是硫化。
usesEn: Tyres are springy and hard-wearing because sulfur bridges the rubber chains together — that is vulcanisation.

name: Buckminsterfullerene
summaryZh: 60 个碳原子构成 20 个六边形和 12 个五边形，形状与足球完全一致。每个碳只与三个碳相连。
summaryEn: Sixty carbons forming 20 hexagons and 12 pentagons, exactly the shape of a football. Every carbon bonds to just three others.
usesZh: 1985 年发现，1996 年即获诺贝尔化学奖。实际应用仍以研究为主：有机太阳能电池、润滑材料和药物载体。
usesEn: Discovered in 1985 and awarded the Nobel Prize in 1996. Practical use is still mostly research: organic solar cells, lubricants and drug carriers.
everydayZh: 有机太阳能电池受体材料
润滑与耐磨添加剂研究
everydayEn: Acceptor material in organic solar cells

name: Water
summaryZh: 键角 104.5°，小于理想四面体角，因为氧上的两对孤对电子排斥更强。极性使水成为优良溶剂。
summaryEn: The 104.5° angle is narrower than a perfect tetrahedron because the two lone pairs on oxygen repel more strongly. Its polarity makes water an excellent solvent.
usesZh: 能溶解的物质比任何其他液体都多，所以细胞里的化学反应、洗衣服和工业冷却都靠它。
usesEn: It dissolves more substances than any other liquid, which is why cell chemistry, laundry and industrial cooling all rely on it.

name: Hydrogen peroxide
summaryZh: 两个 O—H 不共面，二面角约 111.5°，是典型的非平面分子 —— 旋转模型最能看清这一点。
summaryEn: The two O-H bonds are not coplanar: the dihedral angle is about 111.5°. Rotating the model is the clearest way to see this.
usesZh: 分解后只剩水和氧气，不留残留，因此适合伤口消毒和食品级漂白；高浓度则可作火箭推进剂。
usesEn: It breaks down into just water and oxygen with no residue, so it suits wound antisepsis and food-grade bleaching; concentrated, it is a rocket propellant.

name: Hydrogen sulfide
summaryZh: 臭鸡蛋气味的剧毒气体。键角仅 92.1°，远小于水，因为硫更少发生轨道杂化。
summaryEn: A highly toxic gas smelling of rotten eggs. Its 92.1° angle is far narrower than water because sulfur hybridises much less.
usesZh: 沼气、下水道和温泉的臭鸡蛋味就是它。剧毒且高浓度下会麻痹嗅觉，是常见的工业事故气体。
usesEn: The rotten-egg smell of biogas, sewers and hot springs. Highly toxic, and at high concentration it deadens the sense of smell — a frequent industrial hazard.
everydayZh: 下水道与沼气的臭味来源
工业有毒气体监测对象
everydayEn: The smell in sewers and biogas
Source of sulfur from sour gas

name: Carbon monoxide
summaryZh: 无色无味剧毒气体。与血红蛋白结合力约为氧气的 200 倍，因而导致煤气中毒。
summaryEn: A colourless, odourless and highly toxic gas. It binds haemoglobin roughly 200 times more strongly than oxygen does.
usesZh: 无色无味却剧毒，与血红蛋白结合力约为氧气的 200 倍 —— 冬季燃气热水器和炭火中毒的元凶。
usesEn: Colourless, odourless and deadly: it binds haemoglobin about 200 times more tightly than oxygen, the cause of winter heater and charcoal poisonings.
everydayZh: 一氧化碳报警器的监测对象

name: Carbon dioxide
summaryZh: 直线形分子，两个 C=O 极性相互抵消，整体无极性。主要的温室气体之一。
summaryEn: Linear, so the two polar C=O bonds cancel and the molecule as a whole is non-polar. One of the principal greenhouse gases.
usesZh: 汽水的气泡、干冰的白雾、灭火器的喷射都是它；同时也是植物光合作用的原料和头号温室气体。
usesEn: The fizz in soda, the fog from dry ice and the blast from an extinguisher — and also the raw material of photosynthesis and the leading greenhouse gas.
everydayEn: Dry ice for cooling and stage fog

name: Sulfur dioxide
summaryZh: 刺激性气味气体，是酸雨的主要成因之一。硫上有一对孤对电子，使分子呈角形。
summaryEn: A pungent gas and a major cause of acid rain. A lone pair on sulfur bends the molecule instead of leaving it linear.
usesZh: 葡萄酒瓶上的"含亚硫酸盐"就来自它 —— 能抑菌抗氧化；但排入大气会形成酸雨。
usesEn: The "contains sulfites" on a wine label traces back to it: an antimicrobial and antioxidant. Released into the air, though, it makes acid rain.

name: Ammonia
summaryZh: 三角锥形，氮上的孤对电子占据第四个顶点。工业上由哈伯法合成，是化肥的基础。
summaryEn: Trigonal pyramidal, with the lone pair on nitrogen occupying the fourth vertex. Made industrially by the Haber process and the basis of fertiliser.
usesZh: 哈伯法合成氨把空气中的氮变成化肥，被认为是养活了地球上约一半人口的化学反应。
usesEn: The Haber process turns air into fertiliser; it is often credited with feeding roughly half the people alive.

name: Hydrogen chloride
summaryZh: 强极性分子，溶于水即为盐酸。
summaryEn: A strongly polar molecule; dissolved in water it becomes hydrochloric acid.
usesZh: 胃里就有它，负责消化蛋白质和杀灭细菌；家里的除垢剂、洁厕灵也主要靠盐酸。
usesEn: Your stomach makes it to digest protein and kill bacteria; household descalers and toilet cleaners are mostly hydrochloric acid.

name: Hydrogen fluoride
summaryZh: 极性极强，分子间氢键很强，因此沸点远高于同族的 HCl。水溶液能腐蚀玻璃。
summaryEn: Extremely polar with strong hydrogen bonding, so it boils far higher than HCl. Its solution etches glass.
usesZh: 唯一能腐蚀玻璃的常见酸，用于玻璃蚀刻和芯片清洗；但会穿透皮肤直接侵蚀骨骼，极其危险。
usesEn: The one common acid that attacks glass, used for etching and wafer cleaning — but it penetrates skin and attacks bone, making it extremely dangerous.

name: Hydrogen cyanide
summaryZh: 剧毒，有苦杏仁味。三个原子严格共线，碳氮之间是三键。
summaryEn: Highly toxic, smelling of bitter almonds. All three atoms are collinear, with a triple bond between carbon and nitrogen.
usesZh: 极少量即可致命，是历史上臭名昭著的毒物；工业上却是电镀金银和制造有机玻璃的必需原料。
usesEn: Lethal in tiny amounts and infamous as a poison, yet industrially essential for gold and silver plating and for making acrylic glass.
everydayZh: 苦杏仁与木薯中的天然来源
everydayEn: Naturally present in bitter almonds and cassava

name: Nitric oxide
summaryZh: 含奇数电子的自由基，在人体内是重要的信号分子。画作双键，实际键级约 2.5。
summaryEn: An odd-electron radical and an important signalling molecule in the body. Drawn as a double bond, though its true bond order is about 2.5.
usesZh: 人体自身合成它来舒张血管 —— 硝酸甘油治心绞痛和伟哥的作用机理都与之相关，相关研究获 1998 年诺贝尔奖。
usesEn: The body makes it to relax blood vessels: nitroglycerin for angina and Viagra both work through this pathway, research that won the 1998 Nobel Prize.
everydayZh: 体内血管舒张信号分子
新生儿肺动脉高压吸入治疗
汽车尾气与空气污染物
everydayEn: Inhaled therapy for newborn lung hypertension

name: Nitrogen dioxide
summaryZh: 红棕色有毒气体，光化学烟雾的成因之一。氮上的单电子使键角张开到 134°。两个 N—O 实际等长。
summaryEn: A red-brown toxic gas and a driver of photochemical smog. The single electron on nitrogen widens the angle to 134°. Both N-O bonds are in fact equal.
usesZh: 城市空气质量指标里的"二氧化氮"就是它，主要来自机动车尾气，是光化学烟雾和酸雨的推手。
usesEn: The NO2 on urban air-quality dashboards, mostly from vehicle exhaust, and a driver of photochemical smog and acid rain.

name: Nitrous oxide
summaryZh: 俗称笑气，早期用作麻醉剂。原子顺序是 N—N—O 而非对称排列。
summaryEn: Laughing gas, once used as an anaesthetic. The atoms run N-N-O rather than symmetrically.
usesZh: 俗称笑气。牙科和分娩镇痛仍在使用，食品上则用作奶油发泡剂 —— 但滥用吸食会造成不可逆的神经损伤。
usesEn: Laughing gas: still used in dentistry and childbirth analgesia, and as the propellant in whipped cream — but recreational abuse causes irreversible nerve damage.

name: Sulfur trioxide
summaryZh: 硫上没有孤对电子，三个氧完全对称地摊在一个平面上。溶于水生成硫酸。
summaryEn: With no lone pair on sulfur, the three oxygens spread symmetrically in one plane. Dissolving it in water gives sulfuric acid.
usesZh: 本身很少直接使用，但它是接触法制硫酸的关键一步 —— 全球每年数亿吨硫酸都要经过它。
usesEn: Rarely used directly, but it is the pivotal step of the contact process: every one of the hundreds of millions of tonnes of sulfuric acid passes through it.

name: Boron trifluoride
summaryZh: 硼只有 6 个价电子，未达八隅体，因此是强路易斯酸，极易接受电子对。
summaryEn: Boron carries only six valence electrons instead of an octet, making BF3 a strong Lewis acid that readily accepts an electron pair.
usesZh: 典型的路易斯酸，极易夺取电子对，因此是有机合成和聚合反应中最常用的催化剂之一。
usesEn: A textbook Lewis acid that eagerly grabs electron pairs, making it one of the most-used catalysts in organic synthesis and polymerisation.

name: Phosphine
summaryZh: 剧毒气体。键角只有 93.5°，比氨小得多 —— 磷几乎不发生轨道杂化。
summaryEn: A highly toxic gas. Its 93.5° angle is far tighter than ammonia because phosphorus barely hybridises its orbitals.
usesZh: 磷化铝熏蒸剂遇水放出膦气，是粮仓杀虫的主要手段；剧毒，也用于半导体掺杂。
usesEn: Aluminium phosphide fumigant releases phosphine on contact with moisture, the mainstay of grain-store pest control; highly toxic, it also dopes semiconductors.
everydayZh: 半导体 n 型掺杂

name: Sulfur hexafluoride
summaryZh: 六个氟严格对称包围硫，极其稳定惰性，常用作高压电气设备的绝缘气体。也是强效温室气体。
summaryEn: Six fluorines wrap sulfur in perfect symmetry, giving a very inert gas used as insulation in high-voltage equipment. Also a potent greenhouse gas.
usesZh: 绝缘性能远超空气，高压开关柜里灌的就是它 —— 但它是已知最强的温室气体，单分子效应约为二氧化碳的两万倍。
usesEn: A far better insulator than air, which is why high-voltage switchgear is filled with it — yet it is the most potent greenhouse gas known, about 20 000 times CO2 per molecule.

name: Phosphorus pentachloride
summaryZh: 罕见的五配位分子：三个氯在赤道面上呈 120°，两个氯在轴向。轴向键比赤道键更长也更弱。
summaryEn: A rare five-coordinate molecule: three chlorines at 120° around the equator and two on the axis. The axial bonds are longer and weaker than the equatorial ones.
usesZh: 有机合成中最常用的氯化试剂之一，能把羟基一步换成氯原子，是制药和农药合成的常规工具。
usesEn: One of the most common chlorinating reagents in organic synthesis, swapping a hydroxyl for chlorine in a single step — routine in pharmaceutical and agrochemical work.

name: Xenon tetrafluoride
summaryZh: 稀有气体并非绝对不反应 —— 这是最早合成的氙化合物之一。氙上的两对孤对电子分居上下，把四个氟压成平面正方形。
summaryEn: Noble gases are not entirely inert: this was among the first xenon compounds made. Two lone pairs sit above and below, flattening the four fluorines into a square.
usesZh: 1962 年前，教科书还断言稀有气体不能形成化合物。氙化合物的合成直接改写了化学的基本认知。
usesEn: Before 1962 textbooks insisted noble gases could not form compounds. Making xenon compounds rewrote a basic assumption of chemistry.
everydayZh: 改写稀有气体化学的实验
everydayEn: The experiment that rewrote noble-gas chemistry

name: Sulfuric acid
summaryZh: 产量最大的工业化学品。硫居四面体中心，两个 S=O 较短，两个 S—OH 较长，可电离出两个质子。
summaryEn: The most-produced industrial chemical. Sulfur sits at the centre of a tetrahedron with two short S=O bonds and two longer S-OH bonds, releasing two protons.
usesZh: 产量常被用来衡量一个国家的工业规模。汽车电瓶里的电解液就是稀硫酸，管道疏通剂也多以浓硫酸为主。
usesEn: Its output is a classic measure of a country’s industrial scale. The electrolyte in a car battery is dilute sulfuric acid, and drain openers are often concentrated acid.

name: Nitric acid
summaryZh: 强氧化性酸。整个分子共平面，氮周围三个氧的夹角并不相等。
summaryEn: A strongly oxidising acid. The whole molecule is planar, and the three oxygens around nitrogen are not evenly spaced.
usesZh: 硝酸铵化肥和几乎所有传统炸药（TNT、硝化甘油）都由它制得；与盐酸混合成王水，可溶解黄金。
usesEn: It makes ammonium nitrate fertiliser and virtually every classical explosive (TNT, nitroglycerin); mixed with hydrochloric acid it becomes aqua regia, which dissolves gold.

name: Phosphoric acid
summaryZh: 磷居四面体中心，一个 P=O 较短，三个 P—OH 较长，可分三级电离。
summaryEn: Phosphorus sits at the centre of a tetrahedron with one short P=O and three longer P-OH bonds, ionising in three stages.
usesZh: 可乐那股独特的涩酸味就来自磷酸；工业上主要用于制磷肥，也用于钢铁除锈和牙科蚀刻。
usesEn: The sharp tang of cola comes from phosphoric acid; industrially it makes phosphate fertiliser and also derusts steel and etches teeth.
everydayZh: 可乐等碳酸饮料酸味剂

name: Hydrazine
summaryZh: 两个氮上的孤对电子互相排斥，使分子扭成邻位交叉构象，而不是像乙烷那样简单交错。
summaryEn: The lone pairs on the two nitrogens repel each other, twisting the molecule into a gauche shape rather than the simple staggering of ethane.
usesZh: 高能量密度且能长期常温储存，是卫星和探测器最常用的姿态控制推进剂；工业上也用作锅炉除氧剂。
usesEn: Energy-dense and storable at room temperature, it is the standard thruster propellant for satellites and probes; industrially it scavenges oxygen from boiler water.
everydayZh: 卫星与探测器姿控推进剂

name: Carbonic acid
summaryZh: 二氧化碳溶于水生成的弱酸，极不稳定，一减压就分解回二氧化碳 —— 这就是汽水开盖冒泡的原因。
summaryEn: The weak acid formed when CO2 dissolves in water. It is so unstable that releasing the pressure breaks it straight back into CO2 — the fizz when you open a bottle.
usesZh: 汽水、啤酒和气泡水里的「气」，本质上是溶解的二氧化碳与它之间的平衡；血液也靠这套平衡稳定 pH。
usesEn: The fizz in soda, beer and sparkling water is really the balance between dissolved CO2 and this acid; blood uses the same equilibrium to hold its pH steady.
everydayZh: 碳酸饮料的酸味与气泡
everydayEn: Fizz and tang in soft drinks

name: Hypochlorous acid
summaryZh: 氯气溶于水生成的弱酸，才是漂白和消毒真正的活性成分 —— 中性分子能穿过细菌细胞膜。
summaryEn: The weak acid formed when chlorine dissolves in water, and the species that actually bleaches and disinfects: being neutral, it can cross bacterial membranes.
usesZh: 84 消毒液、漂白水和泳池氯片起作用时，真正杀菌的都是它；人体的中性粒细胞也会合成它来杀灭病原体。
usesEn: Whatever the label says, bleach, pool chlorine or disinfectant, this is the species that actually kills microbes. Your own neutrophils make it too.
everydayZh: 漂白水与消毒液的有效成分
人体免疫细胞的杀菌武器
everydayEn: Active agent in bleach and disinfectant
A weapon of human immune cells

name: Silane
summaryZh: 甲烷的硅类似物，但遇空气会自燃。芯片和太阳能电池的硅薄膜就是靠它气相沉积出来的。
summaryEn: The silicon analogue of methane, but it ignites in air. Silicon films for chips and solar cells are deposited from it.
usesZh: 芯片、液晶面板和太阳能电池上的硅薄膜，几乎都是让硅烷在高温下分解沉积出来的。
usesEn: The silicon films on chips, LCD panels and solar cells are nearly all deposited by decomposing silane at high temperature.

name: Boric acid
summaryZh: 完全平面的分子，三个羟基像风车一样绕硼排列。晶体里靠氢键连成片层，所以硼酸手感滑腻。
summaryEn: A flat molecule with three hydroxyls arranged like a pinwheel around boron. In the crystal, hydrogen bonds link the molecules into sheets, which is why boric acid feels slippery.
usesZh: 弱酸而温和，杀虫效果却很确定：厨房里对付蟑螂和蚂蚁的硼酸饵剂就是它。也用于眼部冲洗液和玻璃、陶釉配方。
usesEn: A weak, mild acid that is nevertheless a reliable insecticide — the boric-acid bait used against cockroaches and ants. It also goes into eyewash and into glass and ceramic glazes.

name: Methane
summaryZh: 天然气主要成分。正四面体，键角 109.5°，是 sp3 杂化最标准的例子。
summaryEn: The main component of natural gas. A perfect tetrahedron with 109.5° angles, the textbook example of sp3 hybridisation.
usesZh: 天然气的主要成分，家里的燃气灶和热水器烧的就是它；也是仅次于二氧化碳的温室气体。
usesEn: The main component of natural gas that burns in your hob and water heater, and the second most important greenhouse gas after CO2.

name: Formaldehyde
summaryZh: 平面三角形，sp2 杂化。装修材料释放的甲醛是常见室内污染物。
summaryEn: Trigonal planar and sp2 hybridised. Released by some building materials, it is a common indoor air pollutant.
usesZh: 福尔马林（甲醛水溶液）用于保存标本；但人造板和家具胶粘剂释放的甲醛是最受关注的室内污染物。
usesEn: Formalin preserves biological specimens, but the formaldehyde released by engineered wood and furniture adhesives is the most-watched indoor pollutant.
everydayZh: 室内空气污染检测对象

name: Acetylene
summaryZh: sp 杂化，四个原子完全共线。氧炔焰温度可达约 3300 °C，用于焊接切割。
summaryEn: sp hybridised, with all four atoms exactly collinear. An oxyacetylene flame reaches about 3300 °C, hot enough for welding and cutting.
usesZh: 氧炔焰能达到约 3300 ℃，是少数能熔断厚钢板的火焰；也用作水果的人工催熟剂。
usesEn: An oxyacetylene flame reaches about 3300 °C, one of the few hot enough to cut thick steel; it is also used to ripen fruit artificially.

name: Ethylene
summaryZh: 所有原子共面，C=C 双键无法自由旋转。植物激素，可催熟果实。
summaryEn: All six atoms lie in one plane, and the C=C double bond cannot rotate freely. It is also a plant hormone that ripens fruit.
usesZh: 产量最大的有机化工产品，聚乙烯（塑料袋、保鲜膜）就由它聚合而成；同时也是植物自身的催熟激素。
usesEn: The most-produced organic chemical: polyethylene (carrier bags, cling film) is polymerised from it — and it is also the plant hormone that ripens fruit.
everydayZh: 聚乙烯塑料袋与保鲜膜

name: Methanol
summaryZh: 最简单的醇。有毒，误饮可致失明，不可与乙醇混淆。
summaryEn: The simplest alcohol. It is toxic and can cause blindness if swallowed, and must not be confused with ethanol.
usesZh: 外观和气味都像乙醇，却会代谢成甲酸导致失明甚至死亡 —— 假酒中毒的元凶正是它。
usesEn: It looks and smells like ethanol but metabolises into formic acid, causing blindness or death — the culprit behind bootleg-liquor poisonings.

name: Ethanol
summaryZh: 酒精。羟基使其能与水以任意比例互溶，同时保留可溶解油脂的烃基部分。
summaryEn: Drinking alcohol. The hydroxyl group lets it mix with water in any proportion, while the hydrocarbon end still dissolves oils.
usesZh: 75% 浓度杀菌效果最好 —— 太浓会让细菌表面蛋白迅速凝固，反而挡住酒精继续渗入。
usesEn: It disinfects best at 75%: any stronger and it coagulates surface proteins so fast that the seal blocks further penetration.
everydayZh: 医用消毒酒精与免洗洗手液

name: Benzene
summaryZh: 完全平面的正六边形。图中画的是凯库勒式（单双键交替），实际六个 C—C 键完全等长，π 电子离域。
summaryEn: A perfectly flat regular hexagon. The Kekule structure with alternating bonds is drawn here; in reality all six C-C bonds are identical and the pi electrons are delocalised.
usesZh: 塑料、合成纤维、染料和药物的基础原料之一，但已确认为致癌物，工业接触受严格管控。
usesEn: A base feedstock for plastics, synthetic fibres, dyes and drugs — but a confirmed carcinogen, so industrial exposure is tightly controlled.
everydayZh: 确认致癌物，接触受管控

name: Ethane
summaryZh: 天然气的第二大成分。两端甲基呈交错式（相差 60°），这是能量最低的构象 —— 单键可自由旋转。
summaryEn: The second biggest component of natural gas. The two methyl groups sit staggered by 60°, the lowest-energy conformation, since single bonds rotate freely.
usesZh: 天然气中含量第二的成分。工业上主要被裂解成乙烯 —— 也就是变成塑料的第一步。
usesEn: The second most abundant component of natural gas. Industrially it is cracked into ethylene, the first step towards plastic.

name: Propane
summaryZh: 液化石油气的主要成分。碳链并非直线，C—C—C 夹角约 112°。
summaryEn: The main component of LPG. The carbon chain is not straight: the C-C-C angle is about 112°.
usesZh: 液化石油气（LPG）的主要成分，加压即可液化装罐，是野外烧烤炉、热气球和无管道地区的主要燃料。
usesEn: The main component of LPG: it liquefies under modest pressure, fuelling camping stoves, hot-air balloons and homes off the gas grid.

name: Chloromethane
summaryZh: 甲烷的一个氢被氯取代。氯的体积和电负性都远大于氢，分子因此有明显极性。
summaryEn: Methane with one hydrogen swapped for chlorine. Chlorine is both far bigger and far more electronegative, so the molecule is distinctly polar.
usesZh: 有机硅工业的起点 —— 硅橡胶、硅油和防水密封胶都从它开始合成；曾作制冷剂，因毒性淘汰。
usesEn: The starting point of the silicone industry — silicone rubber, oils and waterproof sealants all begin here; once a refrigerant, dropped for toxicity.
everydayZh: 硅橡胶与硅油生产起点

name: Chloroform
summaryZh: 俗称氯仿，早期用作吸入麻醉剂，现主要作溶剂。
summaryEn: Chloroform: once used as an inhaled anaesthetic, now mostly a laboratory solvent.
usesZh: 19 世纪最重要的吸入麻醉剂，但因肝毒性和心律失常风险早已被淘汰；如今主要作实验室溶剂和制冷剂原料。
usesEn: The leading inhaled anaesthetic of the 19th century, long abandoned for liver toxicity and cardiac risk; today mainly a lab solvent and refrigerant precursor.

name: Carbon tetrachloride
summaryZh: 完美的正四面体，四个 C—Cl 极性彼此抵消，整体无极性。曾用作灭火剂，因毒性已淘汰。
summaryEn: A perfect tetrahedron whose four polar C-Cl bonds cancel, leaving the molecule non-polar. Once used in fire extinguishers, now retired for its toxicity.
usesZh: 曾是最常见的灭火剂和干洗溶剂，后来发现它既伤肝又破坏臭氧层，已被《蒙特利尔议定书》全面禁用。
usesEn: Once the most common fire extinguisher and dry-cleaning solvent, until it proved both hepatotoxic and ozone-depleting; now banned under the Montreal Protocol.
everydayZh: 曾用作灭火剂与干洗剂（已禁用）
化学教学的经典非极性分子
everydayEn: A teaching classic for non-polar molecules

name: Acetaldehyde
summaryZh: 酒精在体内的第一步代谢产物，也是宿醉和脸红的元凶。醛基部分是平面的。
summaryEn: The first product of alcohol metabolism, and the cause of hangovers and flushing. The aldehyde group is planar.
usesZh: 酒精在肝脏代谢的第一步产物。亚洲人中约四成乙醛脱氢酶活性偏低，喝酒脸红正是乙醛堆积所致。
usesEn: The first product of alcohol metabolism. Roughly 40% of East Asians have a low-activity variant of the enzyme that clears it, which is why drinking makes them flush.
everydayZh: 酒精代谢中间产物（脸红与宿醉）
everydayEn: Alcohol metabolite behind flushing and hangovers

name: Acetone
summaryZh: 最简单的酮，常见的洗甲水和溶剂。羰基碳与相连的三个原子严格共面。
summaryEn: The simplest ketone, familiar as nail-polish remover and solvent. The carbonyl carbon is exactly coplanar with its three neighbours.
usesZh: 洗甲水的主要成分，也是溶解油脂和树脂能力极强的常用溶剂；人体在长时间断食时也会产生它。
usesEn: The main ingredient of nail-polish remover and a powerful solvent for oils and resins; the body also produces it during prolonged fasting.
everydayZh: 糖尿病酮症的代谢产物

name: Acetic acid
summaryZh: 食醋的酸味来源。羧基中的 C=O 比 C—O 明显更短，这是判断羧酸结构的关键。
summaryEn: What makes vinegar sour. Within the carboxyl group the C=O is clearly shorter than the C-O, the giveaway of a carboxylic acid.
usesZh: 食醋中约含 3–5% 的乙酸，酸味就来自它；家用除水垢、清洁玻璃也常用白醋。
usesEn: Vinegar is 3-5% acetic acid, and that is where the sourness comes from; white vinegar is also a household descaler and glass cleaner.

name: Dimethyl ether
summaryZh: 与乙醇分子式完全相同（C₂H₆O）却是不同的物质 —— 经典的同分异构体。没有羟基，所以沸点低得多。
summaryEn: Same formula as ethanol (C2H6O) but a different substance: the classic pair of structural isomers. With no hydroxyl group it boils far lower.
usesZh: 与乙醇分子式相同却性质迥异，是同分异构的经典范例。作气雾剂推进剂和清洁柴油替代燃料。
usesEn: Same formula as ethanol yet completely different — the textbook case of structural isomerism. Used as an aerosol propellant and a clean diesel substitute.
everydayZh: 化学教学的同分异构范例

name: Toluene
summaryZh: 苯环上接一个甲基，是最常用的有机溶剂之一。苯环仍然完全平面，甲基可自由旋转。
summaryEn: A benzene ring carrying one methyl group, and one of the most widely used organic solvents. The ring stays perfectly flat while the methyl spins freely.
usesZh: 油漆稀释剂和胶水的主要溶剂，也是 TNT 炸药的原料；挥发性强，长期吸入会损伤神经系统。
usesEn: The main solvent in paint thinners and adhesives, and the raw material for TNT; volatile enough that chronic inhalation damages the nervous system.
everydayZh: 油漆稀释剂与胶水溶剂

name: Phenol
summaryZh: 羟基直接连在苯环上。苯环的吸电子作用使它的酸性远强于普通的醇，因此曾叫"石炭酸"。
summaryEn: A hydroxyl bonded straight onto a benzene ring. The ring pulls electron density away, making phenol far more acidic than an ordinary alcohol.
usesZh: 历史上第一种外科消毒剂 —— 李斯特用它把手术死亡率大幅降低；今天则是酚醛树脂和多种药物的原料。
usesEn: The first surgical antiseptic: Lister used it to cut operative mortality dramatically. Today it is the feedstock for phenolic resins and many drugs.
everydayZh: 喉痛喷雾中的局部麻醉成分
everydayEn: Feedstock for aspirin and other drugs

name: Naphthalene
summaryZh: 两个苯环共用一条边，全部十个碳共面。传统樟脑丸的成分。此处按正六边形理想化，实际各 C—C 键长略有差异。
summaryEn: Two benzene rings sharing an edge, with all ten carbons in one plane. The old-fashioned mothball. Idealised here as regular hexagons; the real C-C lengths vary slightly.
usesZh: 传统樟脑丸的成分，靠常温升华出的蒸气驱虫；因健康顾虑，许多国家已改用其他防蛀剂。
usesEn: The active ingredient of old-fashioned mothballs, working through vapour that sublimes at room temperature; health concerns have pushed many countries to alternatives.

name: Urea
summaryZh: 1828 年维勒由无机物合成尿素，第一次打破"有机物只能来自生命"的观念。也是最重要的氮肥。
summaryEn: Wohler made urea from inorganic materials in 1828, breaking the idea that organic compounds could only come from living things. It is also the leading nitrogen fertiliser.
usesZh: 用量最大的氮肥。护肤品里的尿素能锁水软化角质；柴油车加的"车用尿素"则用来分解尾气中的氮氧化物。
usesEn: The world’s leading nitrogen fertiliser. In skincare it holds water and softens keratin; in diesel vehicles, AdBlue urea solution breaks down exhaust NOx.
everydayZh: 柴油车尾气处理液（车用尿素）
人体尿液的主要含氮废物
everydayEn: The main nitrogen waste in urine

name: Glycine
summaryZh: 最简单的氨基酸，也是唯一没有手性的氨基酸。一端是氨基，另一端是羧基 —— 蛋白质就靠这两端相连成链。
summaryEn: The simplest amino acid and the only one without chirality. An amino group at one end, a carboxyl at the other: proteins are chains linked through exactly these two ends.
usesZh: 组成蛋白质的 20 种氨基酸中最小的一个，因为侧链只是一个氢原子，能挤进胶原蛋白紧密的三股螺旋里。
usesEn: The smallest of the 20 protein amino acids: its side chain is a single hydrogen, small enough to fit inside collagen’s tight triple helix.
everydayZh: 蛋白质与胶原蛋白的组成单元
everydayEn: Building block of proteins and collagen

name: Formic acid
summaryZh: 最简单的羧酸。蚂蚁叮咬和荨麻刺痛的灼热感就来自它 —— 拉丁语 formica 正是"蚂蚁"。
summaryEn: The simplest carboxylic acid. The sting of ant bites and nettles comes from it — Latin formica means "ant".
usesZh: 蚂蚁、蜜蜂和荨麻靠它防御。工业上用于皮革鞣制、橡胶凝固和青贮饲料防腐。
usesEn: The defence chemical of ants, bees and nettles. Industrially it tans leather, coagulates rubber latex and preserves silage.
everydayZh: 蚂蚁与蜂类的防御物质

name: Ethylene glycol
summaryZh: 两端各一个羟基，与水强烈氢键结合，能把冰点压到零下几十度 —— 汽车防冻液的主角。有甜味但剧毒。
summaryEn: A hydroxyl at each end hydrogen-bonds strongly with water, pushing the freezing point tens of degrees below zero — the core of engine antifreeze. Sweet-tasting but highly toxic.
usesZh: 汽车防冻液的主成分，也是 PET 塑料瓶和涤纶纤维的两大原料之一。有甜味，宠物误食极易致命。
usesEn: The main ingredient of engine antifreeze and one of the two feedstocks for PET bottles and polyester fibre. It tastes sweet, which makes it deadly to pets.

name: Glycerol
summaryZh: 三个羟基让它极其吸湿，是护肤品最常用的保湿剂；也是所有油脂（甘油三酯）的骨架。
summaryEn: Three hydroxyls make it strongly water-attracting, the most common humectant in skincare — and the backbone of every fat and oil.
usesZh: 护肤品成分表上几乎必有的保湿剂；也是所有油脂的骨架 —— 制皂时把油脂水解，剩下的就是甘油。
usesEn: The humectant on almost every skincare label, and the backbone of all fats: hydrolysing oil to make soap leaves glycerol behind.
everydayZh: 护肤品与化妆品保湿剂

name: Diethyl ether
summaryZh: 1846 年首次公开演示乙醚麻醉，外科手术从此不再是酷刑。今天主要作萃取溶剂，极易燃。
summaryEn: The 1846 public demonstration of ether anaesthesia ended surgery as an ordeal. Today it is mainly an extraction solvent, and extremely flammable.
usesZh: 1846 年乙醚麻醉的公开演示是外科史的分水岭；今天主要作萃取溶剂和柴油发动机冷启动助剂。
usesEn: The 1846 public demonstration of ether anaesthesia was a turning point in surgery; today it is mainly an extraction solvent and a diesel cold-start aid.

name: Ethyl acetate
summaryZh: 洗甲水和白胶那股果香就是它。低毒又易挥发，是咖啡低因处理和油墨工业的常用溶剂。
summaryEn: The fruity smell of nail-polish remover and white glue. Low in toxicity and quick to evaporate, it decaffeinates coffee and thins printing inks.
usesZh: 洗甲水、白乳胶和指甲油那股果香就是它。毒性低、挥发快，还用于咖啡豆脱咖啡因。
usesEn: The fruity smell of nail-polish remover, white glue and nail varnish. Low in toxicity and fast to evaporate, it is also used to decaffeinate coffee.

name: Lactic acid
summaryZh: 酸奶和泡菜的酸味来自它。肌肉剧烈运动时也会产生 —— 但现在认为它不是酸痛的原因，反而是备用燃料。
summaryEn: It gives yoghurt and pickles their tang. Muscles make it during hard exercise — though it is now seen as spare fuel rather than the cause of soreness.
usesZh: 酸奶、泡菜和酸面包的酸味都来自乳酸菌发酵；护肤上作果酸换肤，医用可降解缝线也由它聚合而成。
usesEn: Lactic-acid bacteria give yoghurt, pickles and sourdough their tang; in skincare it is an AHA exfoliant, and polymerised it becomes dissolvable surgical sutures.
everydayZh: 可降解手术缝线与 PLA 塑料

name: Alanine
summaryZh: 第二简单的氨基酸。与甘氨酸只差一个甲基，但这个甲基让它有了手性 —— 生物体只用其中的 L 型。
summaryEn: The second simplest amino acid: one methyl group more than glycine, and that group makes it chiral. Life uses only the L form.
usesZh: 构成蛋白质的 20 种氨基酸之一，肌肉中含量很高。运动时肌肉靠它把氮运回肝脏再合成葡萄糖。
usesEn: One of the 20 protein amino acids and abundant in muscle, which uses it to shuttle nitrogen back to the liver to be remade into glucose.
everydayZh: 肌肉与肝脏间的葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环
食品增味与营养补充剂

name: Vinyl chloride
summaryZh: PVC 的单体：把千万个它首尾相连，就得到水管、地板和人造革。本身是确认的致癌物。
summaryEn: The monomer of PVC: link millions of them end to end and you get pipes, flooring and synthetic leather. The monomer itself is a confirmed carcinogen.
usesZh: 全球第三大塑料 PVC 的单体。水管、电线绝缘层、地板革、人造革和输液袋都由它聚合而来。
usesEn: The monomer of PVC, the third-largest plastic in the world: water pipes, cable insulation, vinyl flooring, synthetic leather and IV bags all come from it.

name: Propene
summaryZh: 聚丙烯的单体，产量仅次于乙烯。保鲜盒、编织袋、口罩熔喷布和绝大多数塑料瓶盖都是聚丙烯。
summaryEn: The monomer of polypropylene, second only to ethylene in output. Food containers, woven sacks, mask meltblown fabric and nearly every bottle cap are polypropylene.
usesZh: 聚丙烯的单体。保鲜盒能进微波炉、编织袋耐撕、口罩熔喷布能滤住颗粒，靠的都是聚丙烯。
usesEn: The monomer of polypropylene: microwave-safe containers, tear-resistant woven sacks and the meltblown filter layer in face masks are all PP.

name: Tetrafluoroethylene
summaryZh: 聚合后就是聚四氟乙烯 —— 不粘锅涂层。氟原子把碳链严严实实裹住，几乎没有东西能粘附上去。
summaryEn: Polymerised, it becomes PTFE — the non-stick coating. The fluorines wrap the carbon chain so completely that almost nothing can stick to it.
usesZh: 聚合后就是特氟龙。不粘锅、防水透气面料、水管生料带和化工耐腐蚀衬里都是它的产物。
usesEn: Polymerised it becomes PTFE: non-stick pans, breathable waterproof fabrics, plumbers thread tape and corrosion-proof chemical linings.
everydayZh: 化工耐腐蚀衬里与轴承

name: Styrene
summaryZh: 聚苯乙烯的单体。发泡后就是外卖餐盒和快递泡沫箱，透明硬质的则是一次性餐具和 CD 盒。
summaryEn: The monomer of polystyrene: foamed it becomes takeaway boxes and packing foam, and as a clear rigid solid, disposable cutlery and CD cases.
usesZh: 聚苯乙烯的单体。发泡后是外卖盒和快递泡沫，透明硬质的是一次性餐具；ABS 塑料（乐高积木）也含它。
usesEn: The monomer of polystyrene: foamed into takeaway boxes and packing foam, clear and rigid for disposable cutlery, and a component of ABS, the plastic of Lego bricks.
everydayZh: 泡沫塑料餐盒与快递填充
一次性透明餐具与 CD 盒
ABS 塑料（乐高、家电外壳）

name: Dichlorodifluoromethane
summaryZh: 曾经的"氟利昂-12"，无毒不燃，一度是完美的制冷剂 —— 直到人们发现它在平流层释放氯原子，撕开了臭氧空洞。
summaryEn: Once "Freon-12": non-toxic, non-flammable and seemingly the perfect refrigerant — until it was found to release chlorine in the stratosphere and tear open the ozone hole.
usesZh: 曾是冰箱和空调的标准制冷剂，也用作喷雾推进剂。1987 年《蒙特利尔议定书》后全球停产 —— 这是人类第一次成功修复全球性环境损害。
usesEn: Once the standard refrigerant in fridges and air conditioners and a common aerosol propellant. Phased out worldwide after the 1987 Montreal Protocol, humanity first successful repair of global environmental damage.
everydayZh: 曾用于冰箱空调制冷（已禁）
曾作喷雾罐推进剂（已禁）
《蒙特利尔议定书》的管控对象
everydayEn: Main cause of the ozone hole

name: Adenine
summaryZh: DNA 四种碱基之一（A），靠两个氢键与胸腺嘧啶配对；也是 ATP 的组成部分 —— 遗传与供能共用同一个骨架。
summaryEn: One of DNA’s four bases (A), pairing with thymine through two hydrogen bonds; it is also part of ATP, so heredity and energy share one skeleton.
usesZh: DNA 与 RNA 的四种碱基之一，在双螺旋中固定与胸腺嘧啶配对；也是 ATP、NAD 和辅酶 A 的组成部分。
usesEn: One of the four bases of DNA and RNA, always pairing with thymine in the double helix; it is also part of ATP, NAD and coenzyme A.
everydayZh: DNA 与 RNA 的碱基 A
everydayEn: The base A in DNA and RNA
Part of ATP, the cell energy currency

name: Caffeine
summaryZh: 结构与腺苷相似，能占住大脑中的腺苷受体却不激活它 —— 于是"困了"的信号送不出去。这就是提神的原理。
summaryEn: Shaped like adenosine, it occupies the brain’s adenosine receptors without activating them, so the "you are tired" signal never gets through. That is how it wakes you up.
usesZh: 世界上使用最广的精神活性物质。咖啡、茶、可乐和能量饮料都靠它提神；也常加进感冒药和止痛药增强药效。
usesEn: The most widely used psychoactive substance in the world, behind coffee, tea, cola and energy drinks; it is also added to cold and pain medicines to boost their effect.

name: Aspirin
summaryZh: 1897 年问世，至今仍是用量最大的药物之一。它不可逆地抑制环氧合酶，所以小剂量长期服用能抗血栓。
summaryEn: Introduced in 1897 and still among the most-used drugs. It blocks cyclo-oxygenase irreversibly, which is why a small daily dose thins the blood.
usesZh: 解热镇痛消炎，还能抑制血小板凝集 —— 心梗和中风高危人群长期服用的小剂量阿司匹林正是靠这一点。
usesEn: It reduces fever, pain and inflammation, and blocks platelet aggregation, which is why people at risk of heart attack or stroke take a small daily dose.
everydayZh: 小剂量抗血栓（心梗、中风预防）

name: Paracetamol
shapeZh: 苯环 + 羟基 + 酰胺
summaryZh: 最常用的退烧止痛药（扑热息痛）。安全窗口窄 —— 过量会直接损伤肝脏，是急性肝衰竭最常见的药物性原因。
summaryEn: The most widely used fever and pain reliever. Its safety margin is narrow: an overdose damages the liver directly and is the leading drug cause of acute liver failure.
usesZh: 最常用的退烧止痛药。不刺激胃、儿童孕妇相对安全，但过量直接损伤肝脏，且许多复方感冒药都含它，容易叠加超量。
usesEn: The most-used fever and pain remedy: gentle on the stomach and relatively safe in pregnancy and childhood, but an overdose damages the liver, and many combination cold remedies contain it so doses stack up easily.
everydayZh: 儿童与孕妇常用退烧药
过量致肝损伤（注意叠加）

name: Glucose
summaryZh: 血糖就是它，也是细胞最直接的能量来源。β 型的所有羟基都处在平伏（equatorial）位置，这是它成为自然界最稳定糖类的原因。
summaryEn: Blood sugar, and the most direct fuel a cell has. In the beta form every hydroxyl sits equatorial, which is why glucose is the most stable sugar in nature.
usesZh: 血糖就是它。大脑几乎只烧葡萄糖，每天约消耗 120 克；也是淀粉、纤维素和糖原的基本单元。
usesEn: This is blood sugar. The brain runs almost exclusively on glucose, burning about 120 g a day, and it is the repeating unit of starch, cellulose and glycogen.
everydayZh: 葡萄糖注射液与口服补液盐
淀粉、纤维素、糖原的单元
糖尿病监测的核心指标
everydayEn: The unit of starch and cellulose

name: Butane
summaryZh: 打火机里晃动的液体就是它 —— 常温下稍加压即可液化，松开阀门立刻汽化。图中是能量最低的反式构象。
summaryEn: The liquid sloshing in a cigarette lighter: a little pressure liquefies it at room temperature and it flashes back to gas at the valve. Shown in its lowest-energy anti conformation.
usesZh: 打火机和便携卡式炉里的燃料。它在常温下稍加压就变成液体，体积缩小几百倍，所以一只小小的打火机能烧很久。
usesEn: The fuel in lighters and portable gas stoves. A little pressure liquefies it at room temperature, shrinking it hundreds of times over, which is why a small lighter lasts so long.
everydayZh: 液化石油气（与丙烷混合）

name: Cyclohexane
summaryZh: 六元环不是平面的：折成"椅式"后每个键角都回到 109.5°，完全没有张力。每个碳一个直立氢、一个平伏氢，转动模型就能看出两者的区别。
summaryEn: The six-membered ring is not flat. Folded into a chair, every angle returns to 109.5° and the ring is strain-free; each carbon carries one axial and one equatorial hydrogen, easiest to tell apart by spinning the model.
usesZh: 主要用来造尼龙 —— 你身上的冲锋衣、背包带、伞面很可能都从它开始。实验室里也是常用的非极性溶剂。
usesEn: Mostly made into nylon, so the shell jacket, rucksack strap and umbrella you own probably started here. It is also a workhorse non-polar solvent.
everydayZh: 教科书里的椅式构象范例

name: Isopropanol
summaryZh: 医用酒精棉片里的消毒成分。羟基长在中间的碳上，比乙醇更油溶，擦拭电子元件不留水痕。
summaryEn: The disinfectant in an alcohol wipe. With the hydroxyl on the middle carbon it dissolves oils better than ethanol and evaporates without leaving water marks.
usesZh: 医用酒精棉片、免洗洗手液和电子产品清洁剂的主力。挥发快、不留痕，擦拭屏幕和电路板比水安全。
usesEn: The workhorse of alcohol wipes, hand sanitiser and electronics cleaner: it flashes off fast and leaves no residue, which makes it safer than water on screens and circuit boards.
everydayZh: 酒精棉片与免洗洗手液

name: Propylene glycol
summaryZh: 两个羟基让它极其吸水，又几乎无毒无味 —— 于是成了食品、化妆品和药品里最常见的保湿剂与溶剂。
summaryEn: Two hydroxyls make it strongly water-attracting while staying almost tasteless and non-toxic, which is why it turns up as the humectant and solvent in food, cosmetics and medicines.
usesZh: 食品级保湿剂，在蛋糕、冰淇淋、牙膏里锁住水分；也是电子烟雾化液和舞台烟雾的主要成分。
usesEn: A food-grade humectant that keeps cake, ice cream and toothpaste from drying out; it is also the main ingredient of vape liquid and stage fog.
everydayZh: 电子烟雾化液、舞台烟雾

name: 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane
summaryZh: 冰箱和汽车空调里的制冷剂 R-134a。它不含氯，不再破坏臭氧层，但仍是很强的温室气体，正逐步被替代。
summaryEn: Refrigerant R-134a, in fridges and car air conditioning. Having no chlorine it spares the ozone layer, but it is still a potent greenhouse gas and is being phased down.
usesZh: 取代氟利昂的第二代制冷剂，冰箱和汽车空调里最常见的一种。不再破坏臭氧层，但温室效应约为二氧化碳的 1400 倍，正被 R-1234yf 等替代。
usesEn: The second-generation refrigerant that replaced CFCs, standard in fridges and car air conditioning. It spares the ozone layer, but warms about 1,400 times as much as CO2, so it in turn is being replaced.
everydayZh: 正被低温室效应制冷剂替代
everydayEn: Being phased down for the climate

name: 1,3-Butadiene
summaryZh: 两个双键隔着一个单键共轭，整个分子被拉成平面。它是合成橡胶的第一原料 —— 轮胎的分子起点。
summaryEn: Two double bonds conjugated across a single bond, which flattens the whole molecule. It is the first feedstock of synthetic rubber — where a tyre begins.
usesZh: 合成橡胶的起点。丁苯橡胶做轮胎，ABS 塑料做乐高积木和家电外壳 —— 都从这个四碳分子开始。
usesEn: Where synthetic rubber starts: styrene-butadiene rubber becomes tyres, and ABS becomes Lego bricks and appliance housings — all from this four-carbon molecule.

name: Isoprene
summaryZh: 天然橡胶就是几千个异戊二烯首尾相连的长链。植物每年向大气释放数亿吨异戊二烯，夏日树林里的清香有它一份。
summaryEn: Natural rubber is thousands of isoprene units linked head to tail. Plants release hundreds of millions of tonnes of it a year — part of the smell of a wood in summer.
usesZh: 天然橡胶的重复单元 —— 橡胶树的乳汁就是异戊二烯长链。它也是萜类香气的基本积木，薄荷醇、柠檬烯都由它拼成。
usesEn: The repeating unit of natural rubber: latex from a rubber tree is long isoprene chains. It is also the building block of the terpenes, so menthol and limonene are assembled from it.
everydayZh: 天然橡胶与合成聚异戊二烯
萜类香气分子的基本单元
植物释放，参与森林气味
everydayEn: Released by plants into forest air

name: Benzoic acid
summaryZh: 最常用的食品防腐剂之一（常以苯甲酸钠的形式加入）。它在酸性饮料里才有效，因为只有未电离的分子能钻进霉菌细胞。
summaryEn: One of the most common food preservatives, usually added as sodium benzoate. It only works in acidic drinks, because only the un-ionised molecule can get inside a mould cell.
usesZh: 常以苯甲酸钠的形式出现在配料表里，抑制霉菌和酵母。它只在酸性环境有效，所以你会在汽水、果汁和酱料里看到它，却很少出现在牛奶里。
usesEn: Usually listed as sodium benzoate, holding back moulds and yeasts. It only works in acid, so it appears in fizzy drinks, juices and sauces but almost never in milk.
everydayZh: 汽水与果汁防腐（苯甲酸钠）
合成苯酚与尼龙的原料

name: Terephthalic acid
summaryZh: 两个羧基分处苯环两端，正好首尾相接聚合成长链 —— 这就是 PET：矿泉水瓶、涤纶衣服和食品托盘的分子骨架。
summaryEn: A carboxyl at each end of the ring, so the molecules polymerise head to tail into long chains. That polymer is PET: water bottles, polyester clothing and food trays.
usesZh: 它与乙二醇缩聚就得到 PET —— 全世界每年几千万吨的矿泉水瓶、涤纶面料和食品托盘都是这两个分子拼出来的。PET 也是最容易回收的塑料之一。
usesEn: Condensed with ethylene glycol it becomes PET: tens of millions of tonnes a year of water bottles, polyester fabric and food trays, all from these two molecules. PET is also among the easiest plastics to recycle.
everydayZh: PET 矿泉水瓶与饮料瓶
可回收再生为再生涤纶

name: Salicylic acid
shapeZh: 苯环 + 羧基 + 羟基
summaryZh: 羟基与羧基相邻，酚羟基的氢正好指向羰基氧，形成分子内氢键 —— 这也是它偏酸、脂溶性强、能钻进毛孔的原因。柳树皮镇痛的成分就是它。
summaryEn: The hydroxyl sits next to the carboxyl, and its hydrogen points straight at the carbonyl oxygen, forming an internal hydrogen bond. That is why it is acidic, fat-soluble and able to get into a pore. It is the painkiller in willow bark.
usesZh: 柳树皮止痛的有效成分，也是阿司匹林的前身。它能溶解角质、疏通毛孔，所以祛痘产品、去屑洗发水和鸡眼贴里都有它。
usesEn: The painkiller in willow bark and the parent of aspirin. It dissolves keratin and clears pores, which is why it turns up in acne products, anti-dandruff shampoo and corn plasters.

name: Methyl salicylate
summaryZh: 冬青油的主要成分，风油精、清凉油和肌肉贴布那股穿透性的气味就来自它。皮肤吸收后水解成水杨酸消炎。
summaryEn: The main component of oil of wintergreen — the piercing smell of muscle rubs and medicated patches. Absorbed through the skin, it hydrolyses back to salicylic acid.
usesZh: 风油精、清凉油、红花油和肌肉贴布那股穿透力极强的气味。涂在皮肤上先觉得凉，再觉得热，然后局部抗炎镇痛 —— 但大量吞服有毒，一小瓶冬青油相当于很多片阿司匹林。
usesEn: The piercing smell of muscle rubs, medicated oils and pain patches: cool first, then warm, then locally anti-inflammatory. Swallowed it is dangerous — a small bottle of wintergreen oil equals a great many aspirin tablets.
everydayZh: 风油精、清凉油与红花油
牙膏与糖果的冬青香型

name: Vanillin
summaryZh: 香草味的来源。天然香草荚里含量不到 2%，价格昂贵，因此市售香草味绝大多数是人工合成的同一个分子 —— 分子层面并无区别。
summaryEn: The smell of vanilla. A natural pod is under 2% vanillin and costly, so almost all vanilla flavour is the synthetic version of exactly the same molecule — chemically indistinguishable.
usesZh: 香草味的全部。冰淇淋、蛋糕、巧克力、香水里都是它；天然香草荚产量有限，市面上绝大部分香兰素由木质素或愈创木酚合成 —— 分子完全一样。
usesEn: The whole of vanilla flavour, in ice cream, cake, chocolate and perfume. Natural pods cannot meet demand, so most vanillin is synthesised from lignin or guaiacol — the identical molecule either way.
everydayZh: 从木质素合成（与天然分子相同）

name: Cinnamaldehyde
summaryZh: 肉桂皮里约 90% 的挥发油都是它，桂皮和肉桂卷的味道就来自这一个分子。苯环与醛基之间的共轭双键让它显淡黄色。
summaryEn: About 90% of the essential oil in cinnamon bark, and the entire smell of a cinnamon roll. The double bond conjugating the ring with the aldehyde is what gives it a pale yellow colour.
usesZh: 肉桂的味道。它还是天然的抗菌剂 —— 古人用肉桂保存食物并非迷信。对昆虫有驱避作用，也被做成环保型驱虫剂。
usesEn: The taste and smell of cinnamon, and a genuine antimicrobial — preserving food with cinnamon was never just superstition. It also repels insects, and is sold as a low-toxicity deterrent.

name: Oxalic acid
summaryZh: 最简单的二元羧酸，两个羧基直接相连。菠菜、苦瓜、茶叶里的涩味有它一份；它与钙结合成难溶的草酸钙，正是常见肾结石的成分。
summaryEn: The simplest dicarboxylic acid — two carboxyls bonded straight together. It contributes the astringency of spinach and tea, and with calcium it forms the insoluble oxalate of the commonest kidney stones.
usesZh: 菠菜、苦瓜、竹笋的涩味来源之一。它和钙结合成不溶的草酸钙，既影响补钙，也是最常见肾结石的成分 —— 焯水就能去掉大部分。工业上是强力除锈剂和木材漂白剂。
usesEn: Part of the astringency of spinach, bitter melon and bamboo shoots. With calcium it forms insoluble oxalate, which blocks calcium uptake and makes the commonest kidney stones — blanching removes most of it. Industrially it is a strong rust remover and wood bleach.
everydayZh: 菠菜等蔬菜中的涩味（焯水可去）

name: Citric acid
summaryZh: 三个羧基加一个羟基，酸得干脆又能牢牢抓住金属离子。柠檬的酸味、汽水的酸味调节剂、除水垢的清洁剂都是它；细胞里的柠檬酸循环也以它命名。
summaryEn: Three carboxyls plus a hydroxyl: sharply sour, and a firm grip on metal ions. It is the tang of a lemon, the acidity regulator in fizzy drinks and the descaler under the sink — and the citric acid cycle in your cells is named after it.
usesZh: 柠檬酸味的来源，也是用量最大的食品酸味剂。它还能螯合金属离子，所以既能除水垢、洗衣服，也能防止果汁氧化变色。细胞里的三羧酸循环就以它命名。
usesEn: The sourness of a lemon and the most-used food acidulant there is. It also grabs metal ions, so it descales kettles, boosts detergents and stops juice browning. The citric acid cycle in your cells is named for it.
everydayZh: 汽水、糖果与果汁酸味剂
细胞三羧酸循环的中间体
everydayEn: An intermediate of the citric acid cycle

name: Ascorbic acid
summaryZh: 就是维生素 C。环上那对烯二醇羟基极易交出氢原子，所以它既能抗氧化，也能让人体合成胶原蛋白 —— 缺了它，血管和牙龈就出问题，这就是坏血病。
summaryEn: Vitamin C. The pair of enediol hydroxyls on the ring gives up hydrogen atoms readily, which makes it both an antioxidant and the cofactor the body needs to build collagen. Without it, blood vessels and gums fail — scurvy.
usesZh: 维生素 C。人类不能自己合成它，必须从食物摄取 —— 长期缺乏就是坏血病。食品工业也把它当抗氧化剂，切开的水果撒点它就不容易发褐。
usesEn: Vitamin C. Humans cannot make it and must eat it — long-term shortage is scurvy. Industry also uses it as an antioxidant: a sprinkle keeps cut fruit from browning.
everydayZh: 维生素 C 补充与防治坏血病

name: Xylitol
summaryZh: 五个碳、五个羟基的糖醇，甜度接近蔗糖但口腔细菌无法发酵它，所以无糖口香糖用它防蛀牙。溶解时吸热，含在嘴里有清凉感。
summaryEn: A five-carbon, five-hydroxyl sugar alcohol: nearly as sweet as sugar, but mouth bacteria cannot ferment it, which is why sugar-free gum uses it against decay. Dissolving absorbs heat, so it feels cool on the tongue.
usesZh: 无糖口香糖的甜味来源。口腔细菌不能发酵它，反而会被它抑制，所以它真的能减少蛀牙。溶解吸热带来清凉感；但它对狗有剧毒，务必收好。
usesEn: The sweetener in sugar-free gum. Mouth bacteria cannot ferment it and are suppressed by it, so it genuinely reduces decay. Dissolving it absorbs heat, hence the cool taste — but it is severely toxic to dogs, so keep it away from them.

name: Glutamic acid
summaryZh: "鲜味"的分子。它的钠盐就是味精，昆布、番茄、干酪、酱油之所以鲜，都是因为游离谷氨酸。它同时是大脑最主要的兴奋性神经递质。
summaryEn: The molecule of savouriness. Its sodium salt is MSG, and the free amino acid is why kelp, tomato, cheese and soy sauce taste of umami. It is also the brain’s main excitatory neurotransmitter.
usesZh: 鲜味的分子基础。它的钠盐就是味精，而昆布、番茄、干酪、火腿之所以鲜，也是因为蛋白质分解出了游离谷氨酸 —— 味精和高汤在舌头上是同一件事。
usesEn: The molecule behind savoury taste. Its sodium salt is MSG, and kelp, tomato, cheese and ham taste savoury for the same reason: protein breaking down into free glutamate. On the tongue, MSG and stock are the same thing.
everydayZh: 昆布高汤、番茄、干酪的鲜味
人体主要的兴奋性神经递质
蛋白质的组成氨基酸之一
everydayEn: Umami in kelp stock, tomato and cheese
One of the protein amino acids

name: Stearic acid
summaryZh: 典型的饱和脂肪酸：一端亲水的羧基，一条十八个碳的疏水长尾 —— 肥皂去污、乳霜乳化、蜡烛成型，靠的都是这条"一头亲水一头亲油"的结构。
summaryEn: The archetypal saturated fatty acid: a water-loving carboxyl at one end and an eighteen-carbon water-hating tail. That one-end-each structure is what makes soap clean, creams emulsify and candles hold their shape.
usesZh: 牛油、可可脂里的主要饱和脂肪酸。它和碱反应成肥皂，是最古老的化学工艺之一；蜡烛、乳霜、巧克力的口感也都靠它。
usesEn: The main saturated fatty acid in tallow and cocoa butter. Treated with alkali it becomes soap — one of the oldest chemical processes there is — and it also gives candles, creams and chocolate their texture.
everydayZh: 巧克力与可可脂的口感

name: Oleic acid
summaryZh: 与硬脂酸只差中间一个顺式双键，链却因此折出约 30° 的弯 —— 分子排不紧密，于是橄榄油在室温下是液体，而硬脂酸是硬块。饱和与不饱和脂肪的差别，看这一个折角就够了。
summaryEn: It differs from stearic acid by one cis double bond, and that single kink kinks the chain by about 30°. The molecules can no longer pack tightly, so olive oil is liquid while stearic acid is a hard solid — the whole saturated-versus-unsaturated story in one bend.
usesZh: 橄榄油约七成是它，也是"单不饱和脂肪"的代表。那个顺式弯折让分子堆不紧密，所以它常温下是液体、也比饱和脂肪更利于血脂。
usesEn: About 70% of olive oil, and the archetype of a monounsaturated fat. The cis kink stops the molecules packing tightly, so it stays liquid at room temperature and treats blood lipids more kindly than saturated fat.
everydayZh: 橄榄油、菜籽油与牛油果
皮肤与头发的天然油脂成分

name: Theobromine
summaryZh: 巧克力里的主要生物碱，比咖啡因少一个甲基。它提神更温和、作用更久；但狗代谢它极慢，所以巧克力对狗有毒。
summaryEn: The main alkaloid of chocolate, one methyl group short of caffeine. Its lift is gentler and longer-lasting — but dogs break it down very slowly, which is why chocolate poisons them.
usesZh: 巧克力提神的主力，可可豆里含量远高于咖啡因。它作用温和而持久，还能舒张血管、镇咳。但狗和猫代谢它极慢，一块黑巧克力就可能致命。
usesEn: What actually lifts you in chocolate — cocoa contains far more of it than caffeine. It works gently and for longer, relaxes blood vessels and suppresses coughs. Dogs and cats clear it very slowly, so a bar of dark chocolate can kill.

name: Uric acid
summaryZh: 人体分解嘌呤的终产物。人类缺少把它继续降解的尿酸酶，血中浓度一高就析出针状晶体扎在关节里 —— 这就是痛风发作的痛。
summaryEn: The end product of purine breakdown. Humans lack the enzyme that would degrade it further, so once blood levels run high it crystallises into needles inside a joint — the pain of gout.
usesZh: 嘌呤代谢的终点。人体每天都在产生它，浓度过高就在关节里结晶 —— 痛风。海鲜、内脏、啤酒之所以被列为"高危"，正是因为嘌呤含量高。鸟类和爬行动物则用它排氮，几乎不耗水。
usesEn: The end of purine metabolism. Your body makes it daily; too much and it crystallises inside a joint — gout. That is why shellfish, offal and beer are on the risk list. Birds and reptiles use it to excrete nitrogen almost without water.
everydayZh: 嘌呤（海鲜、内脏、啤酒）代谢终产物
鸟类与爬行类的排氮方式
everydayEn: The end product of purine metabolism
How birds and reptiles excrete nitrogen

name: Dopamine
summaryZh: 大脑里负责奖赏与动机的神经递质 —— 它传递的与其说是"快乐"，不如说是"值得再来一次"。同一个分子在体外也能被氧化成黑色素，切开的苹果发褐与它同源。
summaryEn: The neurotransmitter behind reward and motivation — it signals "worth doing again" rather than pleasure itself. Oxidised outside the body the same catechol turns into dark pigment, the chemistry that browns a cut apple.
usesZh: 奖赏与动机的神经递质，它编码的是"预期"而不是快乐本身 —— 短视频和老虎机让人停不下来，正是踩中了这个回路。帕金森病则源于产生多巴胺的神经元退化。
usesEn: The transmitter of reward and motivation, encoding anticipation rather than pleasure itself — which is exactly what short-video feeds and slot machines exploit. Parkinson’s disease comes from the loss of the neurons that make it.
everydayZh: 运动控制（帕金森病相关）

name: Adrenaline
summaryZh: "战或逃"的分子：心跳加快、瞳孔放大、支气管扩张、血糖上升，都在几秒内由它触发。过敏性休克的急救笔里装的就是它。
summaryEn: The fight-or-flight molecule: faster heartbeat, wide pupils, open airways and a rise in blood sugar, all triggered within seconds. It is what an anaphylaxis auto-injector contains.
usesZh: 应急激素。危险来临时几秒内让心跳加快、血糖升高、支气管扩张，把身体切换到"战或逃"。也是过敏性休克的急救药 —— 肾上腺素笔能救命。
usesEn: The emergency hormone: within seconds of danger it speeds the heart, raises blood sugar and opens the airways, switching the body to fight-or-flight. It is also the treatment for anaphylaxis — an adrenaline pen saves lives.
everydayZh: 局麻药中收缩血管延长药效

name: Ibuprofen
shapeZh: 苯环 + 支链 + 羧基
summaryZh: 家庭药箱里最常见的消炎止痛药。它抑制环氧合酶，切断前列腺素的合成 —— 于是痛、肿、发热一起降下来。空腹服用伤胃，也是同一个机制的代价。
summaryEn: The anti-inflammatory painkiller in every medicine cabinet. It blocks cyclo-oxygenase and cuts off prostaglandin synthesis, so pain, swelling and fever all subside together — and the same mechanism is why it is hard on an empty stomach.
usesZh: 布洛芬。退烧、止痛、消炎三件事一起做，牙痛、痛经、扭伤、发烧都常用。它抑制环氧合酶，代价是刺激胃黏膜，所以要饭后吃。
usesEn: Fever, pain and inflammation all at once — toothache, period pain, sprains, a temperature. It blocks cyclo-oxygenase, and the price of that is stomach irritation, so it is taken with food.
everydayEn: Taken with food to spare the stomach

name: Menthol
summaryZh: 它并不真的降温，而是直接打开皮肤和口腔里感知寒冷的 TRPM8 通道，大脑于是收到"冷"的信号。牙膏、口香糖、清凉油的凉意都是这样来的。三个取代基都取平伏位，是最稳定的构象。
summaryEn: It does not cool anything: it opens TRPM8, the cold receptor in skin and mouth, so the brain simply receives "cold". That is the chill of toothpaste, chewing gum and muscle rub. All three substituents sit equatorial, the most stable arrangement.
usesZh: 薄荷的清凉。它并不降温，只是打开了皮肤和口腔里的冷觉通道 TRPM8 —— 大脑被"骗"成觉得冷。牙膏、口香糖、清凉油、鼻通吸入剂都靠它。
usesEn: The chill of mint. It does not lower any temperature; it simply opens TRPM8, the cold channel in skin and mouth, and the brain is fooled into feeling cold. Toothpaste, chewing gum, muscle rubs and inhalers all rely on it.

name: Nicotine
summaryZh: 烟草里的成瘾成分。它的形状与乙酰胆碱相似，能骗过神经上的乙酰胆碱受体，几秒内到达大脑并释放多巴胺 —— 成瘾就是这么快建立的。烟草用它来毒杀啃食叶子的昆虫。
summaryEn: The addictive component of tobacco. Shaped enough like acetylcholine to fool nicotinic receptors, it reaches the brain within seconds and releases dopamine — which is how the habit forms so fast. The plant makes it to poison insects that chew its leaves.
usesZh: 烟草成瘾的根源。吸入后约十秒到达大脑，激活乙酰胆碱受体并释放多巴胺，把"再来一根"写进奖赏回路。它本身也是烟草的天然杀虫剂，曾直接用作农药。
usesEn: The reason tobacco is addictive: about ten seconds from lungs to brain, where it activates nicotinic receptors and releases dopamine, writing "one more" into the reward circuit. It is the plant’s own insecticide, and was once sprayed on crops as one.
everydayZh: 香烟与电子烟的成瘾成分
戒烟贴片与尼古丁口香糖
everydayEn: The addictive part of tobacco and vapes

name: Fructose
summaryZh: 水果和蜂蜜里的糖，也是最甜的天然糖 —— 甜度约为蔗糖的 1.7 倍。与葡萄糖是同分异构体，却几乎只在肝脏代谢，这也是果葡糖浆备受争议的原因。
summaryEn: The sugar of fruit and honey, and the sweetest natural sugar — about 1.7 times sucrose. It is an isomer of glucose, yet it is metabolised almost entirely in the liver, which is what makes high-fructose syrup controversial.
usesZh: 水果和蜂蜜里的糖，天然糖里最甜的一个。与葡萄糖组成蔗糖；果葡糖浆则让它大量进入饮料 —— 它几乎只在肝脏代谢，摄入过多与脂肪肝、尿酸升高有关。
usesEn: The sugar of fruit and honey, and the sweetest natural sugar. Joined to glucose it makes sucrose; as high-fructose syrup it floods soft drinks — and because it is metabolised almost entirely in the liver, too much is linked to fatty liver and raised urate.
everydayZh: 过量摄入与脂肪肝相关
everydayEn: Excess is linked to fatty liver

name: Sucrose
summaryZh: 白砂糖。一个葡萄糖的六元环与一个果糖的五元环通过一个氧桥相连，而这个连接用掉了两边的还原性端 —— 所以蔗糖不还原、不易变质，也正因如此适合做糖果和保存食物。
summaryEn: Table sugar: a six-membered glucose ring and a five-membered fructose ring joined through one oxygen. That link uses up the reducing end of both halves, so sucrose is non-reducing and keeps well — which is exactly why it works in sweets and preserves.
usesZh: 白砂糖、冰糖、方糖都是它，从甘蔗和甜菜里提取。除了甜，它还负责焦糖化上色、抑制微生物（果酱和蜜饯正是靠高糖保存），以及在烘焙中保持湿润。
usesEn: Table sugar, rock sugar and sugar cubes are all this one compound, pressed from cane and beet. Besides sweetness it caramelises for colour, holds back microbes — high sugar is how jam keeps — and keeps baking moist.

name: Benzaldehyde
summaryZh: 苦杏仁的气味。杏仁、桃核、樱桃核里的苦杏仁苷水解会同时放出它和氰化氢 —— 香味与毒性来自同一个反应，所以生苦杏仁不能多吃。
summaryEn: The smell of bitter almonds. Amygdalin in almond, peach and cherry kernels hydrolyses to release it together with hydrogen cyanide — the scent and the poison come from one and the same reaction.
usesZh: 苦杏仁味的来源，杏仁精、樱桃味糖果、部分香水都用它。杏核、桃核里的苦杏仁苷分解时会连带放出氰化氢，所以生食苦杏仁有风险。
usesEn: The bitter-almond note in almond essence, cherry sweets and some perfumes. In apricot and peach kernels it is released together with hydrogen cyanide, which is why raw bitter kernels are risky to eat.
everydayZh: 合成染料与药物的中间体

name: Isoamyl acetate
summaryZh: 香蕉和梨的味道，俗称"香蕉水"。酯类普遍闻起来像水果，这是最典型的一个。它也是蜜蜂的报警信息素 —— 一只蜂蜇人后释放它，同伴便循味而来。
summaryEn: The smell of banana and pear, and the classic example of why esters smell fruity. It doubles as a honeybee alarm pheromone: one sting releases it, and the rest of the hive follows the scent in.
usesZh: 香蕉、梨的果香，食品香精里的常客，也用作胶水和指甲油的溶剂（俗称香蕉水）。蜜蜂用它当报警信息素，被蜇后招来更多同伴的就是这个味道。
usesEn: The banana-and-pear note of food flavourings, and the solvent smell of some glues and nail varnish. Honeybees use it as an alarm pheromone — that smell is what calls the rest of the hive in.
everydayZh: 酯类"水果香"的典型代表
everydayEn: Solvent in glue and nail varnish

name: Adipic acid
summaryZh: 与己二胺缩聚就是尼龙 66 —— 丝袜、伞布、安全带、牙刷毛都从这里来。食品工业也用它做酸味剂，泡打粉里那点酸就可能是它。
summaryEn: Condensed with hexamethylenediamine it becomes nylon 66 — stockings, umbrella fabric, seat belts, toothbrush bristles. Food makers also use it as an acidulant; the sour part of some baking powders is this molecule.
usesZh: 尼龙 66 的两种单体之一，产量以百万吨计 —— 丝袜、地毯、安全带、渔线都从它开始。食品里也用作酸味剂，比柠檬酸更不吸潮，适合粉状饮料。
usesEn: One of the two monomers of nylon 66, made by the million tonnes: stockings, carpet, seat belts, fishing line. It is also a food acidulant that, unlike citric acid, does not draw water — handy in powdered drinks.
everydayZh: 粉状饮料与果冻的酸味剂

name: Bisphenol A
summaryZh: 聚碳酸酯和环氧树脂的原料：水壶、眼镜片、罐头内涂层、热敏纸小票都可能含它。它的形状与雌激素有几分相似，能弱结合雌激素受体，因此婴幼儿用品普遍改用"不含 BPA"的替代材料。
summaryEn: The feedstock of polycarbonate and epoxy resin — bottles, lens blanks, tin-can linings, till receipts. Its shape is close enough to oestrogen to bind the receptor weakly, which is why baby products moved to BPA-free alternatives.
usesZh: 聚碳酸酯（水壶、镜片、CD）和环氧树脂（罐头内涂层、地坪、胶）的原料，也用于热敏纸小票的显色。它能弱激活雌激素受体，因此婴童用品与许多水瓶已改用无 BPA 材料。
usesEn: The building block of polycarbonate (bottles, lenses, CDs) and epoxy resin (can linings, floor coatings, glue), and the developer in thermal till receipts. It weakly activates the oestrogen receptor, so baby goods and many bottles have moved to BPA-free materials.
everydayZh: 内分泌干扰争议与"无 BPA"替代

name: Capsaicin
summaryZh: 辣其实不是味觉，而是痛觉：辣椒素直接打开 TRPV1 通道 —— 这个通道本来是用来感知 43°C 以上高温的，于是大脑收到"烫"的信号。它不溶于水，所以喝水没用，喝牛奶或吃油脂才有效。
summaryEn: Heat from chilli is not a taste but a pain signal: capsaicin opens TRPV1, the channel that normally reports temperatures above 43°C, so the brain is told you are being burnt. It does not dissolve in water, which is why water does not help and milk or fat does.
usesZh: 辣椒的辣。辣不是味觉而是痛觉与热觉，所以喝水没用 —— 它不溶于水，要靠牛奶、酸奶或油脂带走。它也被做成镇痛膏药：反复刺激后神经末梢会对疼痛变迟钝。
usesEn: The heat of chilli. Heat is a pain and temperature signal rather than a taste, and since capsaicin will not dissolve in water, drinking water does nothing — milk, yoghurt or oil carries it away. It is also made into pain-relief patches: repeated stimulation leaves nerve endings less responsive to pain.
everydayZh: 辣椒的辣味（TRPV1 痛觉通道）
驱鸟不驱兽的天然屏障
everydayEn: The burn of chilli, via TRPV1
The active agent in pepper spray
A plant defence that birds ignore
